_doc: Sounds for HAIRLINE that no CC0 / BBC archive source covered well, generated locally by scripts/sfx/generate.py (TangoFlux; see docs/assets/sfx.md, 'Generated'). Per item: prompt (+ optional negative_prompt, else negative_prompt_default), duration, loop, variants, cat (the loudness category in recipes.json), cue, and recipe (the catalogue fields what/ch/replaces/bus and any build.py overrides). generate.py makes the takes, scores and picks them, writes .cache/sfx/dl/gen/<name>_NN.wav and scripts/sfx/recipes-gen.json, and build.py builds them like the recorded set. extra_takes adds seeds for low-yield items; exclude ({take: reason}) vetoes takes that QA (scripts/sfx/qa.py, listening) rejected. Items whose first prompt gave few usable takes were rephrased as short AudioCaps-style captions (the style TangoFlux was trained on); the first wording is kept as prompt_v1 and its takes in .cache/sfx/gen/takes-v1/.
negative_prompt_default: music, melody, speech, voices, singing, low quality, distorted, clipping, reverb tail too long, background noise, hiss
